insight.headline: UI extensions now support a larger number of locales
insight.what_changed: UI extensions no longer have a 256 KB limit on the combined size of their locale files. As of October 30, 2026, you can add more languages to an extension without hitting a combined size limit at deploy. This applies to all apps with UI extensions, and no action is required.
